name: Torrent of Souls — +2/+0 and haste only if {R} was spent
notes: Sweep cast-condition leftovers (2026-10-06). "Creatures target player controls get +2/+0 and gain haste until end of turn if {R} was spent to cast this spell." applied unconditionally: the condition ends the sentence with a full stop, which neither the branch splitter's entry test nor its leading-"If" reader looked for. It now moves to a branch line read from a "{R} spent" toggle. The {B} half (return a creature card) is not a continuous effect and gets no toggle. First copy targets you with {R} spent: Grizzly Bears 4/2 with haste. Second copy targets the opponent without it: Hill Giant stays 3/3 without haste.
